name: Outdoor Pizza Oven Dough
desc: Cold-proofed pizza dough for a perfect crispy, chewy crust

ingredients.raw: 535 g high-protein all-purpose flour, such as King Arthur
2 g instant dry yeast, such as SAF
Extra-virgin olive oil, for oiling proofing containers and dough balls

steps: Pulse flour and yeast in food processor. Add water, process 10-20 sec. Rest 20 min.
Add salt, process 20-30 sec until smooth at 75°F.
Oil bowl, rest 45 min, knead briefly, rest 60-120 min.
Divide into four 225g balls. Oil lightly. Refrigerate 24-72 hrs.
Remove 1-2 hours before baking to reach 60°F.
